title: Reimport ignores font updates
body:
### Tested versions

4.6 rc1

### System information

Godot v4.6.rc1 - Nobara Linux 43 (Workstation Edition) on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Laptop GPU - Intel(R) Core(TM) Ultra 9 185H (22 threads) - 62.40 GiB memory

### Issue description

I'm using FontForge to tweak a custom font I made a long time ago, and initially thought that Godot didn't support the kerning options I was tweaking but I think I've pin pointed it to the Reimport button now.

Reimport does not appear to work for fonts. It doesn't matter if one closes the scene and re-opens, or even closes Godot and re-open it after using Reimport, the font does not appear to update.

However, in creating this issue, I moved my Font file away from the original import location and hit the Reimport button, and still Godot popped up a "(Re)importing assets" dialog without saying that the file is missing, which I found odd.

Further, even if I delete the font from the Files in Godot, it still appears in the (embedded) theme, so there also seems to be an issue with some heavy caching going on.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the attached project.
2. Select the font in the Files panel.
3. Hit Reimport in the Import panel.

Result:

A "(Re)importing assets" dialog briefly pops up making the user think that the font has been reimported but it has not, and the old cached font is still displayed in the scene.

Expected:

First, the Reimport button should ask where the file is if it can't find it, and then it should re-generate the font used in all opened scenes which uses it (via themes or otherwise).

Workaround:

1. Delete the font.
2. Add the font to Godot again.
3. Set up your theme with the newly added font.
